summary: Mofast AB (publ) engages in the real estate business primarily in Sweden. The company owns, develops, and manages community and residential properties. It serves private care companies, municipalities, county councils, authorities, and private individuals. The company was formerly known as Mälardalens Omsorgsfastigheter Holding AB (publ) and changed its name to Mofast AB (publ) in November 2021. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
